title: Kelly F NDE 13205
content: During a high school football game, I was injured. It had turned out that I ruptured my spleen in the game. The impact caused my rib to cut the spleen in half. The doctor at the game couldn't diagnose exactly what type of injury I had received. The doctor at the game had just told me to go home and if I don't feel better in the morning go to a doctor. The injury happened during the first quarter of the game and I ended up staying at the game until the end. Following the game, I was starting to be very light headed. My dad took me from the game to the hospital emergency room instead of letting me going home on the team bus. When I got to the hospital, I could walk but only if I stopped every few steps to bend over to let blood get to my head. When I got to the hospital over 2/3rds of my blood was in my stomach cavity. I was told that if I had been 30 minutes later to the hospital, I would have died. In the operating room prior to and possibly during surgery, I was above my body at the ceiling of the room. I was looking down at my body and trying to ask the nurses if they needed help moving me from the gurney to the operating table. I could hear them scrambling around yelling, 'He's in shock!' Then, I was in the whitest light experiencing the most loving, caring, peaceful feeling I ever felt, even to this day. I had just turned 17 and a minute before, was not wanting to die. But when I was in the light, I didn't want to leave and go back to my body. I did return and here I am today. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: Oct 7 1978 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Football Injury. Life threatening event, but not clinical death How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. Seemed more able to feel emotions like love At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? The whole time Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Similar Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Similar Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. A very bright white light but the brightness wasn't irritating to look at What emotions did you feel during the experience? Love, peace Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe. Just that everything above is all love Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Protestant Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes My belief was changed to know that we continue to exist beyond our bodies Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes We are all one During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Uncertain Something was there creating the peaceful, loving environment Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes Jus that I was returned to my body to continue to live and learn here on earth for now During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes I knew that we are much more than our body and our body limits our total existence Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes That love in the realm I was in doesn't exist here on earth What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I think much more about being kind to all people After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Can't find words to describe the unearthly feeling of love How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain Might have a few times heard people speak who I was close to but had passed away Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The fact that I had the NDE made it much easier for me to deal with the passing of people who were close to me since Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes A few years, most people who haven't experienced a NDE have trouble understanding and those that have know exactly the feeling I speak of Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No rgi23rt_nde

environment.environment_other_detail: A very bright white light; "the brightness wasn't irritating to look at".

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in operating room (ceiling vantage) followed by being in a very bright white light; no tunnel, no beings, no boundary described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Attempted to help nurses move his body from gurney to operating table while out of body; heard staff yelling, "He's in shock!"
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "He's in shock!"; "Then, I was in the whitest light experiencing the most loving, caring, peaceful feeling I ever felt"; "Can't find words to describe the unearthly feeling of love".
